summary: Tests assert /identity is 401 unauthenticated and 200 with a read token, body service=='panopticon-task-service', api_revision==1, version==version('panopticon-next') (nonempty), instance_id equal to the resolved launch runtime's id even when the parent process env carries a stale PANOPTICON_INSTANCE_ID, and the auth secret absent from the body; a public endpoint, inherited stale identity, or leaked secret is rejected.
